tool.name: ML inference using BioML

configfiles.configfile:
import os import argparse import numpy import onnxruntime as rt import pandas as pd
data_test = pd.read_excel('$input_file', sheet_name='Test') y_test = pd.DataFrame(data_test, columns=["Response (1:Responder; 0:Non-responder)"]) rf16=["Cancer_Type2", "Albumin", "HED", "TMB", "FCNA", "BMI", "NLR", "Platelets", "HGB", "Stage (1:IV; 0:I-III)", "Age", "Drug (1:Combo; 0:PD1/PDL1orCTLA4)", "Chemo_before_IO (1:Yes; 0:No)","HLA_LOH", "MSI (1:Unstable; 0:Stable_Indeterminate)", "Sex (1:Male; 0:Female)"] x_test16 = pd.DataFrame(data_test, columns=rf16) sess = rt.InferenceSession(os.getcwd() + "/forest16.onnx") input_name = sess.get_inputs()[0].name label_name = sess.get_outputs()[0].name pred_onx = sess.run([label_name], {input_name: x_test16.astype(numpy.float32).values})[0] x_test16["Predictions"] = pred_onx x_test16.to_csv('$output_file', sep="\t", index=None)
